def.acceptedText: Tasks you accepted. The no-fix rate, time taken, reviews, questions to you and related PRs count accepted tasks only
def.after: Instructions added while it worked do not count. The rate is shown from 10 accepted tasks.
def.aiText: Time in progress with an AI running
def.cacheText: Reads from and writes to the cache. As a conversation goes on, rereading its earlier context counts here
def.callsText: Times a tool or MCP tool was called
def.conversationText: Conversations first launched in this span
def.everText: From the first day of records to today
def.finishedTasksText: Accepted tasks and stopped tasks. An accepted task counts on the day it was first accepted
def.finishedText: The same number as under Tasks
def.launchText: Times an agent was started (input passed to one already running excluded)
def.lead: Accepted tasks that meet all three
def.leadText: From the request to the first acceptance
def.mcpText: Tools of MCP servers. Calls inside subagents excluded
def.modelText: The model first given the task
def.one: Sent for review at most once
def.otherText: Time on hold, in error or not started, and time in progress with no AI running
def.perFinishedText: Amount in the interval ÷ tasks finished in it. Work on unfinished tasks is included, so it swings by day
def.perTaskText: Interval total ÷ tasks accepted in it. Hollow points: fewer than 10
def.prText: PRs that appear in the accepted tasks; the same PR counts once
def.questionsText: Questions the AI asked you between the request and the end, withdrawn ones included
def.runText: Total time running, parallel runs added
def.skillText: Launches that called the skill or read its documents
def.submitsText: Times the task was sent for your review before acceptance
def.three: No instruction after acceptance (one coming later takes it out)
def.tokensText: Output + input + cache reads and writes, tasks still at work included
def.tokensUnknown_one: Token totals exclude {{count}} launch without token data
def.tokensUnknown_other: Token totals exclude {{count}} launches without token data
def.two: No send-back and no added instruction while in review
def.usedTasksText: Tasks the AI worked on. A task worked on by several models counts for each, so the total can exceed the finished tasks
def.youText: Awaiting your review, and awaiting your answer to a question
